description:
The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is loaded in InVesalius. A biomedical engineer needs to evaluate the impact of the 'Closing' morphological operation on cranial bone volume for 3D printing preparation. 

Perform the following:
1. Create a mask using the standard 'Bone' threshold (226 to 3071 HU).
2. Generate a 3D surface from this raw mask and export it as a binary STL to '/home/ga/Documents/raw_skull.stl'.
3. Create a second mask (or duplicate the first) and apply the 'Closing' morphological operation to it (use default structural element settings or size 1).
4. Generate a 3D surface from this closed mask and export it as a binary STL to '/home/ga/Documents/closed_skull.stl'.

Both files must be created to allow volumetric comparison.
